messages:
maya_cs: Kicking off AuroraEdge week0 onboarding. Blockers: BYOK attestation pending (CS-12111), egress to partner CIDR blocked, and audit events not arriving at their Splunk HEC. Can infra/sec/ops pick owners?

ravi_infra: I can handle the firewall change once we have exact CIDR+ports and which private subnets to scope. I'll need justification text for the CR.

maya_cs: Partner endpoints: 51.15.200.0/24 port 443 (API) and 51.15.201.0/28 port 8088 (Splunk HEC). Subnets: aurora-private-1, aurora-private-2. They prefer NAT GW. Justification: partner API + audit ingestion. Ticket CS-12111 has BYOK details.

zoe_sec: For BYOK we need attestation (HSM provenance + fingerprint) and the key ARN. Drafted a minimal key policy that scopes usage to the redwood runtime role and denies console decrypts. Posting policy to CS-12111. Note: BYOK may add a compliance review window (~48h).

ellie_ops: Quick Splunk HEC smoke (replace <TOKEN>):

```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST https://splunk.auroraedge.io:8088/services/collector/event -H "Authorization: Splunk <TOKEN>" -d '{"event":"au test"}'
```

If you see 204 it's accepted. Common failures: token mismatch, TLS CA, or NAT egress blocked. Also check VPC Flow Logs to s3://aurora-logs/flow/ for recent files.

deploybot: priv-deploy/aurora-edge v0.5.2 smoke started at 3141592660. status: partial-success. failed: audit-forwarding,kms-policy

ravi_infra: Created change request cr-121 to add egress from aurora-private-* -> 51.15.200.0/24:443 and 51.15.201.0/28:8088 via ngw-7c9. ETA ~6m.

maya_cs: Asked customer to regenerate HEC token and to provide BYOK attestation PDF and key ARN. Also asked whether they'd like Redwood to create the cross-account role or if they prefer to create in their account.

zoe_sec: Recommendation: customer creates role in their account that trusts arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD:role/redwood-log-reader. I'll add a short CFN snippet to the ticket for the role and S3 permissions. Also will append KMS ARN condition if BYOK used.

ellie_ops: After CR propagation I'll rerun the Splunk curl and tail forwarder logs. If token rejects, we'll ask for rotated token.

amanda_am: Customer noted onboarding pace during renewal check. If BYOK approval + sustained audit delivery not confirmed in 72h, escalate to AM + finance and mark renewal at-risk. Flagging on renewal board.

ravi_infra: Firewall change applied (cr-121 active). Please retry Splunk test in 5m.

ellie_ops: Reran curl at 3141592705 -> HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized. Forwarder log: "invalid token". Pasting log to CS-12111.

maya_cs: Customer rotated token and uploaded BYOK attestation. I'm posting both to CS-12111. Zoe, can you review attestation and confirm policy?

zoe_sec: Reviewing attestation now. Policy looks good; will add condition on kms:ViaService and close once signed. Note compliance review may still take an extra 24h.

ellie_ops: Re-ran curl at 3141592718 -> 204 No Content. Forwarder logs show events accepted. Uploading artifacts to CS-12111. Will monitor for 24h and drop evidence.

deploybot: Next check-in scheduled 3141679200 (week1). Reaction :calendar:

maya_cs: Action items: @zoe_sec finalize key policy and close CS-12111; @ravi_infra attach cr-121 and confirm persisted; @ellie_ops monitor Splunk intake 24h and upload logs; @amanda_am to follow renewal board. I'll review tomorrow AM. :white_check_mark:
